claim: Against the 433272-state Proof Atlas and pinned official move system, the 28 live-unsolved exact-depth5 residual rows were tested with a distinct bounded fiber-holonomy mechanism: along a shortest six-context quotient witness, short official-move loops of radius at most 4 that return to the same quotient state generated multiple exact lifts; up to 12 alternatives per checkpoint were retained, the remaining quotient witness was replayed, and an exact tail of depth at most 2 was searched for an Atlas intersection. The search found 482 raw same-fiber exact alternatives across 56 checkpoints, retained and tested 300 alternatives, explored 2,113,506 holonomy states plus 48,000 exact tail states, and produced zero Atlas candidates. This is not a global exact-distance lower bound.
obstruction: The prior failure cannot be explained merely by choosing a single bad quotient lift: substantial local same-fiber holonomy exists on 22 of the 28 residual rows, yet none of the tested local alternative lifts reconnects to the current Proof Atlas through the bounded resumed-witness plus tail construction. Six rows are locally fiber-rigid at radius 4 under the same six-context quotient.
reuse_rule: Do not repeat the radius-4 quotient-null local-holonomy plus depth-2 exact-tail mechanism on these 28 rows against the same Atlas snapshot. A further attempt requires material Atlas growth or a genuinely different bridge representation, such as nonlocal or multi-checkpoint fiber transport; projected hits alone remain non-certifying.
